item.title: How WhatsApp guest calling works (join a call without an account)
item.description: WhatsApp guest calling lets people without an account join voice or video calls from a browser link. How to create a call link, what guests can and cannot do, and the limits at launch.

item.title: How to turn on WhatsApp voice message transcripts
item.description: Built-in WhatsApp voice message transcripts are off by default. How to enable them on Android and iPhone, which languages work, and what still fails on WhatsApp Web.

item.title: WhatsApp scheduled messages are in beta: what we know so far
item.description: WhatsApp is testing scheduled messages on Android beta. What it sends, how far ahead, who has it, and what to do on WhatsApp Web until it arrives.
